He is vaccinated against hepatitis A and B and denies any recent travel abroad. On physical examination, prominent hepatosplenomegaly is noted. Which of the following would confirm the most likely diagnosis in this patient?

opa. Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP)
opb. Contrast CT of the abdomen
opc. Ultrasound of the abdomen
opd. Percutaneous liver biopsy
ope. Magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP)
